body: Coinbase posts steep first-quarter loss after slide in crypto prices, shares fall 4% | The Tech Buzz. Coinbase posts steep first-quarter loss after slide in crypto prices, shares fall 4%. Crypto trading platform Coinbase reported a surprise first-quarter loss and weaker-than-estimated revenue after the market close Thursday. The largest U.S. crypto exchange reported a surprise first-quarter loss and missed revenue estimates after Thursday's market close, sending shares down 4% in extended trading. The results expose how deeply the recent crypto price slide has cut into trading volumes and platform revenue, raising fresh questions about the sustainability of crypto exchange business models during prolonged market downturns. The crypto trading platform posted a surprise first-quarter loss and weaker-than-estimated revenue, catching Wall Street off guard and triggering a 4% share decline in after-hours trading. Coinbase's subscription and services revenue - the segment Wall Street watches closely as a buffer against trading volatility - will be scrutinized when full earnings details emerge. For the crypto industry, Coinbase's performance serves as a bellwether.
